title: App authorization meets playground sign-in
summary:
Apps can request model-scoped access, the playground gained sign-in, and the site added per-page translation.

Third-party apps gained a redirect-based flow for requesting API keys with selected model access. The playground gained Login and Logout controls, and uses the current key for image and text generation.

The site added per-page translation based on browser language, including list content and News, with a visible translation indicator and English fallback. The Apps showcase also fetches its listings from GitHub.

The model-list endpoints filter results for restricted API keys while leaving unrestricted lists intact. `/v1/models` also adopted an OpenAI-compatible list response.

highlights.title: Connect apps, then create
highlights.text: Third-party apps can request access to selected models through a redirect flow. Sign in to the playground to generate images and text with the models available to your key. [Try the playground](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: Pages in your language
highlights.text: Site pages can translate to your browser language, including News and list content. An indicator shows when translation is active, with English as the fallback. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Model lists match access
highlights.text: With a restricted API key, `/v1/models`, `/image/models`, and `/text/models` list only permitted models. `/v1/models` also returns an OpenAI-compatible list. [Browse the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
